verdict.rationale: Supabase documents branches as separate environments for testing schema changes without affecting production, including isolated preview environments per pull request. Its MCP server gives agents branching tools (create_branch, merge_branch, reset_branch, rebase_branch) alongside apply_migration and execute_sql, and the MCP security guidance recommends branching so agents can test changes safely before merging. Missing for 10: the agent branching tool group is labeled experimental, there is no hands-on or independent corroboration of agent-driven branch workflows, and how an agent validates changes within a branch is only implied.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can let an agent create and test schema changes in an isolated branch or preview environment before production

citations.quote: You can use these branching environments to create and test changes like new configurations, database schemas, or features without affecting your production setup.
Branching takes this further, adding isolated preview environments for each pull request.
test changes in a safe environment before merging them to production
